adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces a pathway for storing and rendering un-sanitized HTML as-is. `Post#cook` now returns `raw` when `cook_method == Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` (app/models/post.rb), and RSS/feed imports set `cook_method: :raw_html` and pass `raw: absolutize_urls(url, contents)` with `skip_validations: true` (app/models/topic_embed.rb). The embed view then renders this with `<%= raw post.cooked %>` (app/views/embed/best.html.erb), so any `<script>`/JS in imported feed content will execute in the iframe on the Discourse origin. `EmbedController` explicitly sets `X-Frame-Options = ALLOWALL` (app/controllers/embed_controller.rb), enabling this content to be framed by the configured host; it does not mitigate script execution. `Jobs::PollFeed` pulls `i.content` from `SimpleRSS.parse open(...)` and does not sanitize it before import (app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb), making XSS realistically reachable if the feed/content is attacker-controlled or compromised.
